extraction_notes: The supplied five-page PDF identifies AO3415 as a GOODWORK P-channel enhancement-mode MOSFET and states REV 2.0 2025 JAN.
P-channel signed values are preserved as printed for VGS, VDS, ID, VGS(th), V(BR)DSS, and VSD; resistance and capacitance values remain positive SI quantities.

Both typical and maximum RDS(on) values are transcribed for all three published VGS/ID rows. Table notes identify the RDS(on) rows as repetitive pulse ratings with pulse width limited by junction temperature.
Ciss = 1450 pF, Coss = 205 pF, and Crss = 160 pF are typical values at VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz; the dynamic-parameter note states these parameters have no way to verify.
Transfer, output, RDS(on), body-diode, and threshold-temperature points are direct readings from the supplied typical plots on page 3, rounded to visible grid resolution; no points were interpolated.

The supplied PDF contains no capacitance-versus-VDS plot, so no capacitance curve points were extracted. Additional table fields such as IGSS, IDSS, gFS, gate resistance, switching times, gate charge, and thermal resistance are not represented in the strict MOSFET schema and were not added.
